codes.meaning: receipts from more than one of the eight loop-override families (histogram, scatter, gather, summary, tensor, transpose, stencil, ordinary array/scalar bulk) reached one loop head; unknown or pending indexed receipts are quarantined (or leaked if the slot is occupied), and nothing is published or replayed
codes.justification: Every production loop-override provider builds a receipt for exactly one of the eight families, where a prefix scan's output array and final scalar form one ordinary bulk family, so receipts of several families at one head indicate an internal invariant violation.

codes.meaning: gather output is not fresh zeros, or candidate values or access records disagree with the source gather
codes.justification: The in-process producer computes the candidate from the validated live owners, so a candidate that disagrees with the source operation indicates an internal producer fault.

codes.meaning: gather entry or publication counter would overflow
codes.justification: These counters are bounded by validated fuel and entry counts far below their integer range, so overflow indicates an internal invariant violation.

codes.meaning: gather completion status is neither complete, unknown nor pending; nothing is published
codes.justification: Public checked-source runs use the synchronous in-process producer, which always reports a complete status; any other status arises only from a faulted producer or a forged receipt.

codes.meaning: gather publication would overflow the step counter
codes.justification: These counters are bounded by validated fuel and entry counts far below their integer range, so overflow indicates an internal invariant violation.

codes.meaning: gather loop head or tick spans no longer match the plan's fuel recipe
codes.justification: Plans are bound from the same checked source and verified MIR at entry, so checked source cannot make the plan's source, contract, function or tick recipe differ at publication.

codes.meaning: gather owners could not be borrowed for publication
codes.justification: Preparation refuses, falling back to ordinary execution, unless these live-loop facts hold, and no source code runs between preparation and publication at the same loop head.

codes.meaning: gather loop counter, bound, tick count or remaining fuel disagrees with the completion
codes.justification: Preparation refuses, falling back to ordinary execution, unless these live-loop facts hold, and no source code runs between preparation and publication at the same loop head.

codes.meaning: gather value, index or output slot is not a u32 array, the output is not owned, or the output aliases an input

codes.meaning: gather producer failed after entry; no publication or source replay
codes.justification: The producer only runs on validated, prepaid inputs, so a failure after entry indicates an internal or environment fault, which is never replayed.

codes.meaning: gather plan no longer binds the source hash, verified MIR, program contract digest, function name or fingerprint (including a missing function), or loop span
